batch.description: Jahangirnagar University D Unit (Biological Sciences), academic session 2017-2018, Set-10 — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU A & D Unit question bank), book PDF pp.150-153 (questions on pp.150-153; printed answer table and printed worked solutions on p.153). EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are marked content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official JU keys; cross-source verification is a later stage. The book prints no per-subject headings in this paper (only 'Short Syllabus' and 'Extra Syllabus' boxes); subject blocks follow the printed question numbers, with subjects determined by content in the unit's standard structure: Biology/Zoology Q1-22 (22), IQ Q23-26 (4), Bangla Q27, 28, 31, 32 (4) and English Q29, 30, 33, 34 (4) interleaved, Biology/Botany Q35-56 (22), Chemistry Q57-80 (24) — Biology total 44 (Zoology 22 + Botany 22), numbered continuously biology-01-22 (Zoology Q1-22) and biology-23-44 (Botany Q35-56). The book re-groups the paper by syllabus, so printed question numbers appear out of page order: the 'Short Syllabus' sequence runs across pp.150-153 and seven questions (Q08, Q09, Q36, Q40, Q43, Q46, Q49) are printed in an 'Extra Syllabus' box on p.152; the pack restores printed question-number order 1-80 and records each question's actual PDF page. Key stats: all 80 questions carry a printed key; there are NO dashes; exactly two dual keys — Q39 (a, c) and Q48 (b, d) — each packed as multiple_choice with both letters and answerVerificationStatus 'unverified'. Printed worked solutions (p.153) exist for 14 questions (Short Syllabus: 01, 07, 12, 15, 24, 26, 27, 29, 33, 37, 44, 58, 62; Extra Syllabus: 43) and every one agrees with the answer table. Anomalies preserved as printed: Q01(b) 'mlHg'; Q01's worked solution states diastolic pressure as 60-89 mmHg although every option spans 70-80 (table key kept, tension flagged on the question); Q07's stem and Q17/Q18/Q26/Q60 options print Latin digits amid Bengali text; Q19(b) 'Sehlegel'; Q33's stem ends with six printed dots; Q34(a)-(c) are printed misspellings (the question asks for the correct spelling); Q44(b) 'ইনলেজ'; Q51(d) 'Rheovirus'; Q57's arrow label prints 'গ্লিসারিন'; Q76(a) 'কোব সংশ্লেষণ'; Q77's product prints '2H - CHO(g)'; Q78's stem prints 'এমাইলেজের'. Q79 is the paper's only figure question (benzene + 3Cl2 / UV reaction scheme with structure-diagram options, described in brackets). Two subject-boundary judgements are recorded on the questions themselves: Q35 (commercially used CFC) opens the Botany numeric block Q35-56 and is counted as Botany so the standard 22 + 24 Botany/Chemistry split closes; Q36/Q53 (conjugated-protein pair) sit inside the same Botany block. IMPORT-READY SUBSET after cross-source adjudication vs Satt Academy: 35 of 80 questions verified. row 3: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 5: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 6: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 7: excluded (DIFFER) row 8: excluded (DIFFER) row 10: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 11: excluded (DIFFER) row 16: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 18: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 19: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 24: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 25: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 26: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 35: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 36: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 37: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 38: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 39: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 40: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 41: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 42: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 43: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 44: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 45: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 46: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 47: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 48: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 49: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 50: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 51: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 52: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 53: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 54: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 55: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 56: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 57: excluded (DIFFER) row 59: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 62: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 64: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 69: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 70: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 71: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 76: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 79: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 80: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC)

sourceDocuments.title: Udvash জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক (JU A & D Unit question bank)
sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. Set-10 of JU D Unit 2017-2018 occupies book PDF pp.150-153 (printed book pp.149-152): questions pp.150-153, printed answer table ('উত্তরমালা ও ব্যাখ্যামূলক সমাধান') on p.153 followed by printed worked solutions for selected questions — Short Syllabus: 01, 07, 12, 15, 24, 26, 27, 29, 33, 37, 44, 58, 62; Extra Syllabus: 43. Every worked-solution key agrees with the answer table. Paper header (book PDF p.150) confirmed before transcription: জাবি ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৭-১৮ শিক্ষাবর্ষ, পূর্ণমান: ৮০, ইউনিট: D, সেট: 10, সময়: ৫৫ মিনিট. Transcription by direct visual reading of every page, with zoomed re-reads of the answer table and of Q01, Q03, Q04-Q14, Q15-Q22, Q23-Q27, Q28-Q34, Q35-Q39, Q41-Q42, Q44-Q45, Q47-Q51, Q52-Q63, Q64-Q72, Q73-Q80 and the Extra Syllabus box. Mathematical/chemical notation linearised (^ for superscripts and superscript charges, plain digits for subscripts, e.g. NADH2, K2Cr2O7, HSO4^-, SO4^2-).
